attempts.text:
**The window opens on a spine.** Columns 0 to 4, `mraZ` to `ilvI`, are carried by 95 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls. The model names 99 to 99.6% of them, fewest at column 4, `ilvI`, 99%.

**A fork at column 5, `protein YabR`, carried by 64%**, opens the middle. Then the `leu` genes, columns 6 to 11, [[isopropylmalate dehydratase]].

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 96 against 93%, and hesitates less there, 0.21 against 0.26 bits. Its most hesitant column, 59, `IS1 family transposase`, is a variable column, at 0.81 bits.

**The window ends on a fork and variable stretch.** Columns 73 to 79, `yaaX` to `yjjY`, are carried by 37 to 86% of chromosomes, all persistent. The last column is `yjjY`, in 37% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 96% of genes**, 0.22 bits on average, perplexity 1.2 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.81 against 0.20 bits, and names fewer genes, 74% against 96%.

label: mraZ
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the mraZ window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor mraZ, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,632 to 3,711 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying mraZ once); 43,200 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 96% of genes, 0.22 bits on average (perplexity 1.2 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 39,597 calls, named 99%, 0.15 bits; shell 3,487 calls, named 60%, 0.99 bits; cloud 116 calls, named 1%, 2.06 bits. Outside an RGP 41,924 calls, named 96%, 0.20 bits; inside an RGP 1,276 calls, named 74%, 0.81 bits. Columns: 68 spine, 3 fork, 9 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.81 against 0.20 bits) and names fewer genes (74% against 96%); 1,276 of the 43,200 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 59 ("IS1 family transposase", a variable column) 0.81 bits, RGP 8%; column 26 (djlA, a spine column) 0.79 bits, RGP 0%; column 60 (nhaR, a spine column) 0.68 bits, RGP 11%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 68 spine columns: named 96%, 0.21 bits on average; the 12 fork and variable columns: named 93%, 0.26 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 59, is a variable column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 63 (fork), RGP 25%; the least: columns 0-4 (spine), RGP 0%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-4 (5 columns) spine: share 95-100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: mraZ, cra, fruR, ilvN "acetolactate synthase small subunit", ilvI. named 99-99.6% (mean 99%), fewest named at column 4 (ilvI), named 99%; most hesitant at column 2 (fruR), 0.23 bits.
[S2] 2. column 5 fork: share 64%, all S, RGP 0%. named 74%; 0.36 bits.
[S2.c5]    5: "protein YabR" S 64%; also "hypothetical protein" S 14%
[S3] 3. columns 6-11 (6 columns) spine: share 92-96%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: leuO, leuL, leuA, leuB, leuC "3-isopropylmalate dehydratase large…", leuD. named 95-99.8% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 7 (leuL), named 95%; most hesitant at column 6 (leuO), 0.66 bits.
[S4] 4. column 12 variable: share 61%, all S, RGP 0%. named 96%; 0.41 bits.
[S4.c12]    12: setA S 61%
[S5] 5. columns 13-42 (30 columns) spine: share 92-96%, all P, RGP 0-2%. Genes: sgrT "glucose uptake inhibitor SgrT", sgrR, thiB "thiamine ABC transporter substrate…", thiP, thiQ, yabI "DedA family protein", araC, araB, araA "L-arabinose isomerase", araD, polB, rapA, rluA, djlA, lptD, surA, pdxA, rsmA, apaG, apaH "bis(5'-nucleosyl)-tetraphosphatase…", folA, kefC, kefF "glutathione-regulated potassium-eff…", yaaU "MFS transporter", fixX, fixC, fixB "electron transfer flavoprotein subu…", fixA, caiT "L-carnitine/gamma-butyrobetaine ant…", caiA. named 77-100% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 26 (djlA), named 77%, 0.79 bits.
[S6] 6. column 43 variable: share 90%, all P, RGP 0.4%. named 97%; 0.29 bits.
[S6.c43]    43: caiB P 90%
[S7] 7. columns 44-58 (15 columns) spine: share 90-96%, all P, RGP 0.4-4%. Genes: caiC, caiD, caiE, caiF, carB, carA "glutamine-hydrolyzing carbamoyl-pho…", dapB, rihC, ispH, fkpB, lspA, ileS, ribF, yaaY "DUF2575 family protein", rpsT. named 93-98% (mean 96%), fewest named at column 53 (fkpB), named 93%; most hesitant at column 58 (rpsT), 0.28 bits.
[S8] 8. column 59 variable: share 26%, all S, RGP 8%. named 79%; 0.81 bits.
[S8.c59]    59: "IS1 family transposase" S 26%
[S9] 9. columns 60-62 (3 columns) spine: share 95-96%, all P, RGP 11-23%. Genes: nhaR, nhaA "Na+/H+ antiporter NhaA", mokC. named 82-89% (mean 86%), fewest named at column 62 (mokC), named 82%; most hesitant at column 60 (nhaR), 0.68 bits.
[S10] 10. column 63 fork: share 44%, all S, RGP 25%. named 81%; 0.50 bits.
[S10.c63]    63: "IS4-like element IS421 family transposa…" S 44%; also "fimbria/pilus periplasmic chaperone" S 23%
[S11] 11. columns 64-72 (9 columns) spine: share 90-95%, all P, RGP 4-24%. Genes: dnaJ "molecular chaperone DnaJ", dnaK, yaaI "DUF2541 family protein", msyB, satP, mog, tal, yaaJ "alanine/glycine:cation symporter fa…", yaaA "peroxide stress protein YaaA". named 83-99% (mean 94%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 64 (dnaJ), named 83%, 0.47 bits.
[S12] 12. columns 73-79 (7 columns) fork and variable columns: share 37-86%, all P, RGP 1-2%. named 98-99% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 78, named 98%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.18 bits (column 73).
[S12.c73-78]    columns 73-78 variable, share 49-86%, all P: yaaX "DUF2502 domain-containing protein" 86%, thrC 83%, thrB 76%, thrA "bifunctional aspartate kinase/homos…" 67%, thrL 58%, yjtD "tRNA/rRNA methyltransferase" 49%
[S12.c79]    79 fork: yjjY P 37% "protein YjjY"; also arcA P 22%
